```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(ggsci)
library(janitor)
```



## BioProject
```{r}
animals_vaccines_bioproject_result <- read_csv("animals_vaccines_bioproject_result.csv", 
    col_names = FALSE)
datacuration_clean = animals_vaccines_bioproject_result %>%
 drop_na() %>% 
  mutate(study = if_else(X1 =="Title", X2, NA)) %>% 
  fill(study, .direction = c("down")) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = X1, values_from = X2) %>% 
  select(-study) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  mutate(title = str_remove(title, "^\\d+\\.\\s"),
         organism = str_remove(organism, "Organism: "),
         organism = str_remove(organism, "Taxonomy ID "),
         bio_project_accession = str_remove(bio_project_accession, "BioProject Accession: "),
         id = str_remove(id, "ID: "))

datacuration_clean

datacuration_clean %>% 
  write_csv(here("tables", "datacuration_step2.csv"))
```


```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
datacuration_clean %>%
  group_by(organism) %>% 
  summarize(n_organism = n()) %>% 
  # filter(!str_detect(organism,"Homo sapiens")) %>% 
  arrange(-n_organism) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = n_organism,
      y = organism %>% fct_reorder(n_organism)) +
  geom_col(fill = "black") + 
  theme_light()+
  geom_text(aes(label = n_organism),
            hjust = -0.2,
            size =3) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0.01,0.01),
                     limits = c(0, 900)) +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.95,0.5),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10,
                               color = "black",
                               angle = 0),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10,
                               color = "black",
                               angle = 0),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.title.y = element_text(color = "black"),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(size = 0, 
                                    linetype = 2,
                                    color = "gray75"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(size = 0.25, 
                                    linetype = 2,
                                    color = "gray75"),
    axis.line.x = element_line(size = 0.5,
                               colour = "black",
                               linetype = 1),
    axis.line.y = element_line(size = 0 ,
                               colour = "black",
                               linetype = 1),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(size = 0.5, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.y = element_line(size = 0.5, color = "black"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 0, 0, "cm")
  ) +
    labs(x = "Frequency",
       y = "",
       title = "BioProject data curation",
       subtitle = "Immunization and vaccination datasets",
       caption = "Search terms: (('vaccine'[All Fields] OR 'immunization'[All Fields]\nOR 'vaccinated'[All Fields] OR 'vaccination'[All Fields] OR 'vaccines'[All Fields]) AND 'transcriptome gene expression'[Filter]\n AND 'material transcriptome'[Filter] AND 'capture_whole'[Filter] AND 'org mammals'[Filter] AND 'Mus musculus'[Organism]") 
  
```
```{r}
mice_vaccination_mining = datacuration_clean %>% 
  filter(str_detect(organism,"Mus musculus")) %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(str_to_lower(title), "cancer|tumor")) %>% 
  filter(str_detect(str_to_lower(title), "vaccin|immuniz"))


mice_vaccination_mining %>% 
  write_csv(here("tables", "mice_vaccination_mining.csv"))
```



```{r}
library(rentrez)

bioprojectid = mice_vaccination_mining$id[[1]]
bioproject_meta = entrez_summary(db = "bioproject", id = bioprojectid) %>% 
  as.tibble() %>% 
  select(project_name,
         project_description,
         organism_name,
         project_id,
         project_data_type,
         project_target_material,
         project_target_capture,
         organism_name)
  


#Loop
bioproject_ids <- mice_vaccination_mining$id

# Função para extrair metadados de cada BioProject
get_bioproject_metadata <- function(bioprojectid) {
  entrez_summary(db = "bioproject", id = bioprojectid) %>%
    as.list() %>%
    tibble::as_tibble() %>%
    select(
      project_id,
      project_name,
      project_description,
      organism_name,
      project_data_type,
      project_target_material,
      project_target_capture
    ) %>%
    mutate(bioproject_id = bioprojectid)  # adiciona o ID original
}

# Aplicar a função a todos os IDs
bioproject_metadata_df <- map_dfr(bioproject_ids, 
                                  ~entrez_summary(db = "bioproject", id = bioprojectid) %>%
    as.list() %>%
    tibble::as_tibble() %>%
    select(
      project_id,
      project_name,
      project_description,
      organism_name,
      project_data_type,
      project_target_material,
      project_target_capture
    ) %>%
    mutate(bioproject_id = bioprojectid))

# Visualizar
print(bioproject_metadata_df)


```
